entry.title: Before You Board | Health Considerations for International Travel

media:group.media:title: Before You Board | Health Considerations for International Travel
media:group.media:description:
For more information about Global Patient Services, please visit https://cle.clinic/43d36at
International travel can present unexpected health challenges, from destination-specific risks and vaccination considerations to accessing medical care far from home. Cleveland Clinic and Global Guardian collaborate through Global MedConnect, combining Cleveland Clinic’s medical expertise with Global Guardian’s global security, assistance and response infrastructure to support travelers around the world.
In this webinar, Cleveland Clinic experts and Global Guardian discuss key health considerations for international travel, including: •Vaccination planning and pre-travel health considerations •Destination-specific health risks •What to do if you become ill or injured while traveling abroad •Navigating medical care in another country •When medical evacuation may be necessary
Learn more about staying informed, preparing for potential health concerns and navigating medical needs while traveling internationally.
Meet our panelists: Tyler Verdeyen, Global Guardian (moderator) Patricia Bartley, MD, Cleveland Clinic Pooja Cerrato, PharmD, Cleveland Clinic Christopher N. White, MD, MS, Global Guardian
Like this video? Hit like and subscribe for more! #clevelandclinic #internationalhealthcare #globalhealthcare
